programme.title: The Outsider
programme.desc: An investigation of a dead daughter begins when a military contractor Lex Walker (Craig Fairbrass) arrives in Los Angeles and he finds the body is not his daughter's. Lex Walker, a British mercenary battling in Afghanistan who drops everything to hurry to Los Angeles when he is informed that his daughter Samantha, who he has not seen in many years, has been found dead. When he arrives at the morgue to identify the body, he is for some reason unsurprised to discover that it is not hers. So he begins a one-man investigation into her whereabouts, trailed by the suspicious detective (Jason Patric) assigned to the case. He soon makes his way to Samantha's boss, Karl Schuster (James Caan), the millionaire CEO of a high-tech company who offers sympathy but little help. It quickly becomes obvious that Schuster is hiding something, since he displays no hesitation about shooting one of his henchmen to death in his own office. Aided by a sexy barmaid (Shannon Elizabeth) enticed by his offer of a $10,000 finder's fee, the take-no-prisoners Lex sets out getting to the bottom of the mystery, beating up or shooting the myriad human obstacles who get in his way. It all leads to his discovery of a massive identity-theft scheme engineered by Schuster about which Lex's very much alive daughter (Melissa Ordway) has the goods.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: The story is about Kunal (Kunal Khemu) who believes he can do anything by trying his hardest. He receives a job offer through his friend Shawn (Teeshay) and his wife Nandini (Puja Gupta (actress)) in Cape Town and moves there with his wife Aarzoo (Amrita Puri). They live a happy life together, until Kunal becomes extremely workaholic. Kunal's nature irritates Aarzoo which leads to frequent outbursts and quarrels. Kunal becomes the most trusted employee of his boss Dharmesh Zaveri (Manish Chaudhary). This thing angers Dinesh Zaveri, Dharmesh Zaveri's younger brother. Kunal advances in his job. Soon Dharmesh is revealed to be an underworld gangster. The company Kunal works in deals with exporting diamonds; Kunal has no idea that it happens illegally. His boss, Mr. Zakaria, sends his hot colleague Rosa to charm Kunal and take him away from his wife. Following the day when Kunal gets drunk in a party, Rosa takes advantage and manages to make love with him. Kunal reaches his house and finds Aarzoo sleeping and accidentally wakes her up, after which they both pick up a quarrel. Soon enough, Kunal realises the crime he is a part of and decides to and leave Cape Town. However, Zakaria knows that Kunal is aware of the illegal business and the only way to keep him silent is to kill him.

When his winning of a high-profile case thrusts him into the limelight, he decides to move his wife and their two kids out of their mixed lower-middle-class town and into the posh enclave of Greenwich, Connecticut.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Barcelona" - "Partizan"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris“ - Belgrado „Crvena Zvezda“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Barcelona" - "Partizan"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Coasts. From the frozen Arctic Ocean, where polar bears and reindeer battle for survival, to the warm beaches of the Mediterranean, home to pink flamingos and killer corals, Europe's coastline attracts a staggering array of wildlife.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Reptile Planet
programme.desc: Skittering, swimming and even gliding, over 12,000 species of reptiles roam the world. Crocs, turtles, snakes and lizards have ancestors as old as the dinosaurs and evolution as their friend. These cold-blooded creatures have adapted in clever and lethal ways, from armoured skin and poisonous venom to record-breaking bite force and even blood squirting eyes. This is Reptile Planet!

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: "Animal Fight Club: Power Struggles" reveals how the even the most epic battles can be won or lost in a split second. In the world of wild animal fights, nothing is ever certain. Whether an animal is fighting for food, shelter or for survival itself, there are no guarantees. Sometimes even strength of numbers is not enough. In this episode we see a female leopard fight a bigger male for her lunch and her life, discover the complex competition amongst the world's largest Great Apes and see how a Nile Monitor Lizard can turn its tail into a show stopping weapon.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's new livestock aren't potty trained; their sheep hut isn't draining properly and has now been transformed into a Pee Palace. It's late fall and the winter deep freeze is just around the corner, so the family needs to get it fixed fast. The Pol's also get a new sheep for their farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol clan gets to work on creating Beth's dream garden. To beat the incoming rainstorm, an exhausted Ben works around the clock to finish building the garden's pond and waterfall. Noticing her brother is near his breaking point, Beth plans a special surprise to lift his spirits.

programme.title: Out There with Jack Randall
programme.desc: At the tender age of 14, Jack Randall left his home in the UK to work under the guidance of legendary wildlife expert Steve Irwin. Developing his skills of handling reptiles and snakes, Randall learned important skills under Irwin's tutelage that remain with him today. Now an accomplished zoologist, Randall is continuing his studies into wild and exotic species, visiting harsh landscapes and unrelenting environments to explore these animal's behaviours. Using his bold and courageous approach, Randall gets up close and personal with deadly snakes, vicious crocodiles, boisterous kangaroos, fierce camels and many other dangerous species.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Cheetahs Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie arrives in the Serengeti as the spectacular wildebeest migration kicks off. He's here to film the fastest land animal on Earth: the cheetah. He gets close to a mother caring for her tiny cubs and a young group of males executing phenomenal hunts as a team, and learns about the unexpected challenges the species face.

programme.title: Australia's Wild Woodlands
programme.desc: "Australia's Wild Woodlands" explores the rich biodiversity and resilience of Australia's eucalyptus forests, home to the world's largest variety of parrots and iconic species like the platypus. These woodlands span vast regions and support diverse wildlife, from red kangaroos to freshwater crocodiles. The film showcases the rare behaviors of marsupials and birds, highlighting threats from climate change and land clearing. Ancient ecosystems remain largely unchanged since the dinosaurs, but species like the Gouldian finch face uncertain futures. Through intimate storytelling, the documentary reveals the ecological importance and fragility of these vibrant landscapes.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: From the National Geographic, this documentary series explores the deadliest animals that inhabit out planet. We travel around the globe to numerous different countries, continents and ecosystems, revealing the most dangerous animals in each location. Whether it's the fearsome lions of Africa, the tyrannical tigers of India, the Amazon's menacing giant anaconda, or the frightening creatures that lurk in our seas and oceans, this fascinating series with stunning cinematography takes a look at each creature in great detail, revealing how each one can be so deadly.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction. Today, these "boss crocs" have continued to not only survive but thrive.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: From the National Geographic, this documentary series explores the deadliest animals that inhabit out planet. We travel around the globe to numerous different countries, continents and ecosystems, revealing the most dangerous animals in each location. Whether it's the fearsome lions of Africa, the tyrannical tigers of India, the Amazon's menacing giant anaconda, or the frightening creatures that lurk in our seas and oceans, this fascinating series with stunning cinematography takes a look at each creature in great detail, revealing how each one can be so deadly.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Are Ewe Pregnant?. The Pol's are preparing for sheep to give birth, which means figuring out how to catch and shear their four Merino ewes - no small task as this is new territory for everyone except Dr. Pol.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's been a year of farming for the Pol family. Even with Charles recovering from his injury, the farm's showing no signs of slowing down! Beth takes the next step with her bees to grow the colony and harvest honey. Charles and Ben come up with a final fix for the sheep hut's drainage problem. The whole family comes together to plant the garden and celebrate a successful year on the farm.

programme.title: Monkey Wars
programme.desc: The Simien Mountains in Ethiopia are home to geladas, the only monkey in the world that grazes. They form large and powerful family groups with complex social hierarchies and fickle relationships. Young bachelor males yearn for power, and when the time is right, they take their chance to grab it with great violence. The alpha male faces a world of pressure on his shoulders. He must ensure the safety of his family while battling challenges from other males. However, the real power in the group comes from the females. They are the ones who truly run the show.

programme.title: Cannibal Sharks
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Cannibal Sharks pulls in two of the world's leading shark experts to unpack and analyze the mounting evidence that shark-on-shark attacks happen a lot more than we ever realized.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: HOSTILE PLANET is a ground-breaking wildlife series that explores Earth's most hostile environments. Over the course of six episodes, we explore the extremes of deep, high, cold, hot, wet and dry and reveal the truly extraordinary ways in which animals have adapted to survive in the face of great adversity. It's always been a HOSTILE PLANET and yet, in the last 40 years, it's got a whole lot tougher for the wildlife. The world has changed more in the last 40 years than at any time in the last 65 million. So animals in the most hostile places on Earth must adapt in the blink of an evolutionary eye. Facing everything from intrinsically hostile habitats and brutally punishing weather to the unrelenting threat of predators and intense competition for resources, their challenge is simple: adapt or die.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: HOSTILE PLANET is a ground-breaking wildlife series that explores Earth's most hostile environments. Over the course of six episodes, we explore the extremes of deep, high, cold, hot, wet and dry and reveal the truly extraordinary ways in which animals have adapted to survive in the face of great adversity. It's always been a HOSTILE PLANET and yet, in the last 40 years, it's got a whole lot tougher for the wildlife. The world has changed more in the last 40 years than at any time in the last 65 million. So animals in the most hostile places on Earth must adapt in the blink of an evolutionary eye. Facing everything from intrinsically hostile habitats and brutally punishing weather to the unrelenting threat of predators and intense competition for resources, their challenge is simple: adapt or die.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Not your average bunch of teenagers, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles have been expertly trained by their anthropomorphic rat sensei, Splinter, in the art of ninjutsu. Criminals of New York beware, beneath the streets of this concrete metropolis, Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael are waiting to put their training into practice, battling evil forces within the city and restoring peace. From petty thieves, to evil overlords, to aliens of an unfamiliar kind, New York is safe in the hands of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles!

programme.title: Sanjay and Craig
programme.desc: This animated comedy show follows the outrageous and often gross-out antics of a enthusiastic and curious 12-year-old boy named Sanjay Patel and his best friend and a master of disguise, a talking snake named Craig. These two are match made in heaven as they find themselves in crazy and hilarious situations every day in their home town of Lundgren. They complete each other and together they are ready to face any challenges and difficulties that life has ahead for them.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Strangely, the animals are happy, the zoo is a paradise, and life couldn't be better! Zookeeper Frances takes outstanding care of all of them or does she? Something sinister bubbles under the surface the happy animals are actually androids, and the real animals are held captive in a dungeon. They're too messy and Zookeeper Frances can't stand a mess! A rescue comes from a very unlikely source, and the final battle could go either way!".

programme.desc: "Pet's Peeved: The notorious Vesuvius Twins have adopted Skipper and King Julien and brought the animal's home to their luxury apartment. Not to spoil and pamper - but to fight each other over shiny baubles! The rest of the penguins and lemurs attempt a rescue but are captured themselves and made to perform in a painful "circus" the twins put together. The tables are going to need to be turned to get this circus out of town. Byte-Sized: Kowalski has another breakthrough invention, tiny robots that group together and not only fix broken tools and appliances, but run them as well. The penguins can just sit back and let the "Nanites" take care of all their chores! The problem is, the Nanites are programmed to protect the penguins at all costs, and ultimately seal the birds inside their lair. The only way to escape is to do battle with a giant, nasty, Nanite robot.".

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Private has an arch enemy in the form of Dale the snail. Why does this snail hate Private so much? It's because Private allegedly smashed the little guy, and keeps smashing him albeit accidentally. Even a public apology ends with Dale getting crushed. Sadly, Dale should never have been enemies with Private to begin with - it was a different penguin who did him wrong. // King Julien becomes enamored of a giant toilet the penguins have built. He wants to use it as his new throne, only the toilet is actually a stink bomb the penguins built to trap Dr. Blowhole. Julien accidently gets trapped, bound tightly to the bomb, so the penguins must try to stop it from detonating, all while going on a wild truck chase through New York. They end up in a New Jersey dump, and Skipper must show a sensitive side before all is lost.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "The Most Dangerous Game Night:Marlene plans a game night to help the zoo animals bond but it takes a terrible turn when the snacks run out. While Kowalski, Maurice, and Mort go on a snack run the gaming animals begin to fight over the games - cheating, sore losing, unwilling participation… chaos! The snack runners get trapped by the law at the store, and the zoo animals have to reconcile quickly in order to pull off a risky rescue. This isn't the kind of bonding Marlene had in mind! Street Smarts: Elmer the dog wants a friend, and thinks he found one in Mort. The penguins are compelled to rescue him, but Elmer doesn't want to give the little lemur up! Max the cat is recruited to help, and Max uses his dog expertise to lead the boys to the giant dog. Mort is rescued, but at what cost? The penguins think Max has met his slobbery doom in the jaws of the giant mastiff.".

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: Edison - L'uomo che illumino' il mondo
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch, Tom Holland e Michael Shannon nel biopic su Thomas Edison. L'avvincente storia del pioniere dell'industria elettrica che ha cambiato la vita degli esseri umani.

programme.title: L'ordine del tempo
programme.desc: Edoardo Leo, Claudia Gerini e un grande cast italiano in un film di Liliana Cavani. Alcuni amici si trovano in una villa sul mare quando scoprono che un asteroide potrebbe colpire la Terra.

programme.title: Per un pugno di dollari
programme.desc: Sergio Leone dirige Clint Eastwood nel primo capitolo restaurato della trilogia del dollaro. Un pistolero risolve la lotta tra due famiglie di contrabbandieri.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: Dogtooth
programme.desc: Terzo film di Yorgos Lanthimos, premiato a Cannes. Tre fratelli vivono confinati in una villa in una realta' distorta creata dai genitori. L'arrivo di un'estranea cambiera' tutto.

programme.title: The Fabelmans
programme.desc: Michelle Williams e Paul Dano nel film piu' intimo e autobiografico di Steven Spielberg. Quando l'armonia della sua famiglia si incrina, Sammy si rifugia nella settima arte.

programme.title: Napoli - New York
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores dirige Pierfrancesco Favino in un dramma tratto da un soggetto di Federico Fellini e Tullio Pinelli. Napoli, 1949: con la speranza di ritrovare la sorella, l'orfanella Celestina si imbarca da clandestina con l'amico Carmine su una nave per New York.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per Spike Lee e Oscar alla sceneggiatura. Un poliziotto afroamericano si infiltra nel Ku Klux Klan per indagare sul razzismo nell'America degli anni 70.

programme.title: Di nuovo in gioco
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood, Amy Adams e Justin Timberlake in un film su padri e figli. Un anziano talent-scout del baseball ricuce il rapporto con la figlia mentre cerca un nuovo campione da lanciare.

programme.title: Edison - L'uomo che illumino' il mondo
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch, Tom Holland e Michael Shannon nel biopic su Thomas Edison. L'avvincente storia del pioniere dell'industria elettrica che ha cambiato la vita degli esseri umani.

programme.title: November - I cinque giorni dopo il Bataclan
programme.desc: Jean Dujardin nella pellicola che ricostruisce le indagini sugli attentati del 2015. Fred, un poliziotto dell'antiterrorismo, deve trovare i fuggitivi più ricercati di Francia.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al War Movie di Christopher Nolan che ripercorre la storica Operazione Dynamo. 1940: la difesa degli inglesi, attaccati dai nazisti, viene narrata da un triplice punto di vista.

programme.title: Le assaggiatrici
programme.desc: Grande successo per il film di Silvio Soldini ispirato a una storia vera. Germania 1943. Un gruppo di donne è reclutato per testare che i pasti di Hitler non siano avvelenati.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sette Oscar e un Golden Globe al film di fantascienza di Alfonso Cuaron, con Sandra Bullock e George Clooney. La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry & Son
programme.desc: Timothy Spall e Vanessa Redgrave nella biografia del pittore britannico L. S. Lowry. Figlio di una donna che scoraggia quotidianamente le sue ambizioni, l’aspirante artista lavora ogni giorno con l’obiettivo di dipingere un quadro che possa rendere la madre fiera di lui.

programme.title: Jurassic World - La rinascita
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Mahershala Ali nel settimo kolossal della saga, diretto da Gareth Edwards. Su un'isola abitata da voraci mostri preistorici, una squadra speciale deve estrarre dal sangue delle creature un campione di DNA con cui sviluppare un farmaco rivoluzionario.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Chris Pratt e Bryce Dallas Howard nel primo capitolo della nuova trilogia prodotta da Spielberg. Per attrarre più visitatori, gli scienziati progettano un dinosauro geneticamente modificato.

programme.title: Jurassic World – Il regno distrutto
programme.desc: Chris Pratt e Bryce Dallas Howard nel secondo capitolo della nuova trilogia. Owen e Claire scoprono una cospirazione mentre tentano di salvare i dinosauri da un'eruzione.

programme.title: Jurassic World - Il Dominio
programme.desc: Il cast delle due spettacolari trilogie si incontra nel sesto capitolo di successo. Dopo la distruzione di Nublar, i dinosauri vagano liberi sulla Terra invasa da locuste giganti.

programme.title: Jurassic World - La rinascita

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Jurassic World - Questo O Quello - Jurassic World.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al cult di Steven Spielberg, dal romanzo di Michael Crichton. Uno scienziato crea un parco a tema preistorico, popolato da animali estinti generati in laboratorio.

programme.title: Il mondo perduto: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo diretto da Steven Spielberg, con Jeff Goldblum e Julianne Moore. Due scienziati ostacolano un criminale che vuole trasportare i feroci dinosauri nello zoo di San Diego.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Sam Neill nel terzo capitolo della saga con protagoniste le bestie preistoriche. Il paleontologo Grant torna sull'isola di Sorna e scopre l'esistenza di nuovi mostri più evoluti.

programme.title: Jurassic World - La rinascita
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Mahershala Ali nel settimo kolossal della saga, diretto da Gareth Edwards. Su un'isola abitata da voraci mostri preistorici, una squadra speciale deve estrarre dal sangue delle creature un campione di DNA con cui sviluppare un farmaco rivoluzionario.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: L'iniziazione
programme.desc: Chris Pine nella quinta pellicola della saga nata dalla penna di Tom Clancy. Ryan vola a Mosca per sventare un folle piano terroristico che farebbe crollare l'economia statunitense.

programme.title: Caccia a Ottobre Rosso
programme.desc: Sean Connery e Alec Baldwin nel primo film dedicato all'agente della CIA, Jack Ryan. 1984: un sottomarino atomico diventa l'altissima posta in gioco nella Guerra Fredda tra Usa e Urss.

programme.title: Giochi di potere
programme.desc: Harrison Ford nel thriller dal romanzo di Tom Clancy. In vacanza a Londra, l'agente della CIA Jack Ryan sventa un attentato dell'IRA ma viene braccato dal fratello di un terrorista.

programme.title: Sotto il segno del pericolo
programme.desc: Ritorna Harrison Ford nei panni di Jack Ryan nel terzo film dai romanzi di spionaggio di Tom Clancy. L'agente sfida una banda di narcotrafficanti colombiani protetti dal governo americano.

programme.title: Al vertice della tensione
programme.desc: Thriller con Ben Affleck e Morgan Freeman nel quarto film basato su Jack Ryan, il personaggio creato da Tom Clancy. Il giovane analista della CIA deve fermare un gruppo di terroristi.

programme.desc: Travolgente avventura animata targata Sky Original. Hank, un adorabile cane che sogna di diventare samurai, prende lezioni da un maestro, ma un perfido gatto minaccia il villaggio.

programme.desc: Terzo avventuroso capitolo tratto dal romanzo di Cecile Aubry. Un uomo sostiene di essere il proprietario di Belle; ma Sebastien farà di tutto per non separarsi dalla fedele amica.

programme.desc: Dagli autori di "Cattivissimo me", lo spin-off che ripercorre la storia dei buffi personaggi, sempre alla ricerca di un cattivo da servire: dalla Preistoria fino alla Londra degli anni 60.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Cattivissimo me", una commedia musicale sulla magia del palcoscenico. In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: Il giorno piu' bello del mondo
programme.desc: Commedia di grande successo per tutta la famiglia diretta e interpretata da Alessandro Siani. Un impresario teatrale deve difendere un bambino speciale da un team di scienziati.

programme.title: I Croods
programme.desc: Avventura nella preistoria firmata DreamWorks. Alla ricerca di un rifugio dopo un terremoto, il cavernicolo Grug e la sua famiglia scoprono un mondo popolato da fantastiche creature.

programme.title: I Croods 2 - Una nuova era
programme.desc: Seconda avventura animata per gli sprizzanti cavernicoli. Dopo aver accolto il giovane Guy, i Croods vanno in cerca di un luogo chiamato ‘casa’. Una volta trovato, dovranno fare i conti con i suoi abitanti, l'evoluto clan dei Superior, finché una nuova minaccia non porterà le due famiglie a unire le loro forze.

programme.title: Il cacciatore di giganti
programme.desc: Il regista di "X-Men" spalanca la porta di un mondo fantasy. Grazie a dei fagioli magici, il giovane contadino Jack si ritrova in un regno abitato da mostri giganteschi che vogliono conquistare la Terra, come accaduto tanti secoli prima quando l’intero pianeta era sotto il loro dominio. Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: Dagli autori di "Cattivissimo me", lo spin-off che ripercorre la storia dei buffi personaggi, sempre alla ricerca di un cattivo da servire: dalla Preistoria fino alla Londra degli anni 60.

programme.title: Latte e la pietra magica
programme.desc: Animazione tratta dai libri di Sebastian Lybeck. Per scongiurare la siccità, una femmina di porcospino e il suo amico scoiattolo devono recuperare una magica pietra rubata da Re orso.

programme.title: Lego Batman - Il film
programme.desc: Animazione digitale e mattoncini Lego si combinano di nuovo per un’avventura targata DC. Batman si allea con la Justice League per sconfiggere i supercattivi capitanati da Joker.

programme.title: Me contro Te: Il film - Vacanze in Transilvania
programme.desc: Sofi', Lui' e i loro amici volano in Transilvania per impedire a Viperiana e alla banda di Malefici di impossessarsi di un potente diamante custodito nel castello del piu' temuto dei vampiri: il Conte Dracula.

programme.title: Il giorno piu' bello del mondo
programme.desc: Commedia di grande successo per tutta la famiglia diretta e interpretata da Alessandro Siani. Un impresario teatrale deve difendere un bambino speciale da un team di scienziati.

programme.title: Il viaggio di Norm
programme.desc: Dal Polo Nord a Manhattan in un esilarante film d'animazione. Un orso che sa parlare agli umani raggiunge New York per salvare l'Artico da un imprenditore, ma viene scambiato per un attore.

programme.title: I Croods
programme.desc: Avventura nella preistoria firmata DreamWorks. Alla ricerca di un rifugio dopo un terremoto, il cavernicolo Grug e la sua famiglia scoprono un mondo popolato da fantastiche creature.

programme.desc: Seconda avventura animata per gli sprizzanti cavernicoli. Dopo aver accolto il giovane Guy, i Croods vanno in cerca di un luogo chiamato ‘casa’. Una volta trovato, dovranno fare i conti con i suoi abitanti, l'evoluto clan dei Superior, finché una nuova minaccia non porterà le due famiglie a unire le loro forze.

programme.title: Il cacciatore di giganti
programme.desc: Il regista di "X-Men" spalanca la porta di un mondo fantasy. Grazie a dei fagioli magici, il giovane contadino Jack si ritrova in un regno abitato da mostri giganteschi che vogliono conquistare la Terra, come accaduto tanti secoli prima quando l’intero pianeta era sotto il loro dominio. Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.

Diana e David sono una coppia felicemente sposata ma in cattive acque dal punto di vista economico, tanto da tentare la fortuna fra i tavoli e le slot machine di Las Vegas. In loro soccorso arriva l'allettante proposta di un ricco miliardario: un milione di dollari in cambio di una sola notte d'amore con la donna. programme.desc: Un cast di star hollywoodiane per una commedia sul mistero dell'amore. A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: One winter morning Jess finds lots of ladybird in his barn. Why are they there? That's the Big Question! Mimi tells him that she has lots of ladybirds in her garden in the summer. They're always hungry and brilliant for the plants because they eat all the greenfly. Maybe they're looking for greenfly in his barn? Jess doesn't think so. There are no greenfly in the barn. He goes to ask Baa and Billie for help. They're saying goodbye to Little Bird who's flying away to a warmer country for the winter. Jess thinks maybe the ladybirds are gathering to fly away too and rushes back to his barn to say goodbye. But when he gets there he finds that the ladybirds are now all huddled together and fast asleep. What's going on? Jess goes to ask Willow and finds a hedgehog sleeping under some leaves near the stable. Willow explains that some animals find it hard to find food in the winter, especially if they can't store it, so they eat as much as they can and then go to sleep during the winter. It's called hibe.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Mimi's really upset with Little Bird who keeps eating all her lettuce seeds. Jess wonders how they can stop her. They try putting out extra food for her but Little Bird just eats everything! Jess wonders if covering the seeds with something so that Little Bird can't reach them would work. Mimi says it's a good idea but the sun won't reach the seeds either – which means they won't grow. The only thing that seems to stop t Little Bird is when she sees Jess and is frightened away. But Jess can't stand still in the vegetable patch forever! Willow sees him and tells him he's being a scarecrow. A scarecrow? Yes, something that scares away the birds. Mimi has a brilliant idea to make the perfect scarecrow. A Jess scarecrow. Little Bird stops eating the lettuce seeds and eats from the lovely bird table they put out for her instead. Hooray!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Baa and Billie have built a fantastic new see-saw in the meadow. Jess can't wait to have a go. But when he tries to make it go up and down with him on one end and Baa and Billie on the other he just gets stuck in the air and can't get the see saw down. ‘How can I go up and down on the see saw?' he asks? -desperate to have all the ‘up and down' fun he see the puppies having when they jump on the see-saw. Jess asks Horace the hoppy frog what he knows about ‘up and down', he talks to Willow about scales and weighing things until finally he works it out – if he finds someone roughly the same weight as him – balanced just like the puppies were - he'll do it! He works out that Mimi - of all his friends- weighs about the same as him and just as he worked out they jump on the see saw and go up and down, up and down and have a fantastic time! Yippety Yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess shows Mimi his lovely Nature Collection. She really likes it and wonders what he's going to do with it. Now that's a good question! Jess thinks he'll display it but with the pups racing around it'd soon get damaged. He asks Horace if he could use it to make musical instruments, some things make a great sound but others aren't so good. It's time to go on a picnic with Mimi and his friends. Jess brings his Nature Collection along and when all his friends want to play a game Jess has a great idea. He's found the perfect thing to do with his Nature Collection! They can use them to make a funny obstacle course race. Brilliant!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: JESS and the pups give Baa a peach to eat, thinking it will make a change from grass. But the peach is too hard. How can I make my peach soft? Asks Jess. That's the Big Question! He asks Mimi and watches her kneading clay. She explains she's making the clay soft. Jess tries throwing the peach in the air to soften it but all it does is bruise. Horace tells them that the water in his pond keeps his skin soft so Jess and the pups try to soften the peach in water. But it's still hard. They visit Willow who offers the pups some of her lovely ripe cherries. She explains that the cherries went soft and changed colour when they ripened. Jess realises it's the same for the peach. He waits for it to ripen and then gives it to Baa. It's delicious! And now Jess knows how to make a peach soft. Yippety yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess, Mimi, Baa and Billie are playing a game, kicking a fir cone into a bucket. But it's so cold that poor shivering Billie can't kick properly. They need to find a way Bilie can stay warm enough. Baa's never cold because of his wool. They find a clump of Baa's wool on the ground but it just falls off Billie when Jess puts it on her – and Mimi tells them that glueing it on's a bad idea. What happens when it's summer and Billie wants to be cool? Maybe wrapping her in it, like a blanket, is the answer? It definitely keeps her warm - only problem is, she can't move! They realise that Baa wears a scarf as well. Perhaps they need a scarf for Billie? Mimi knits a tiny scarf for Billie, after twisting the clump of wool into yarn. It's perfect! Billie's toasty warm for their game of Flying Fircones. Yippety Yay!

programme.title: Bride For Rent
programme.desc: A young man trying to get at his inheritance hires a woman to play his bride. But though it's just supposed to be an act, things get unexpectedly real between them.

programme.title: Won't Last A Day Without You
programme.desc: A female radio DJ who has a popular relationship advice show advises a caller to break up with her boyfriend. Much to the DJ's surprise, that boyfriend shows up at the station, asking for restitution. The DJ tries to help him win his girl back, but the two fall in love in the process.

programme.title: Everything About Her
programme.desc: Powerful but ill-stricken business woman, Vilma Santos navigates her complicated relationship with her caregiver, Angel Locsin and her estranged son, Xian Lim in this story about acceptance, love and forgiveness.

programme.title: Bloody Crayons
programme.desc: A group of friends goes to an island for a short film project when they are attacked by a mysterious killer after playing a game of bloody crayons.

programme.title: Sa Init ng Apoy
programme.desc: It's the Holy Week, the end of Lent, a popular time for Filipinos to have a vacation. A young couple travels to Baguio to escape the Metro's summer heat. But before they reach the city proper, their jeep breaks down. Fortunately, they find a transient house with a room to spare. The housekeeper is a mysterious fellow, warm but dreadfully awkward. The couple doesn't mind him though and they even make it an adventure to find out more about their host by asking locals what they know about the house and its keeper. Come Good Friday, the day God dies, they will discover that adventures and vacations don't go well together all the time.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: One winter morning Jess finds lots of ladybird in his barn. Why are they there? That's the Big Question! Mimi tells him that she has lots of ladybirds in her garden in the summer. They're always hungry and brilliant for the plants because they eat all the greenfly. Maybe they're looking for greenfly in his barn? Jess doesn't think so. There are no greenfly in the barn. He goes to ask Baa and Billie for help. They're saying goodbye to Little Bird who's flying away to a warmer country for the winter. Jess thinks maybe the ladybirds are gathering to fly away too and rushes back to his barn to say goodbye. But when he gets there he finds that the ladybirds are now all huddled together and fast asleep. What's going on? Jess goes to ask Willow and finds a hedgehog sleeping under some leaves near the stable. Willow explains that some animals find it hard to find food in the winter, especially if they can't store it, so they eat as much as they can and then go to sleep during the winter. It's called hibe.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Mimi's really upset with Little Bird who keeps eating all her lettuce seeds. Jess wonders how they can stop her. They try putting out extra food for her but Little Bird just eats everything! Jess wonders if covering the seeds with something so that Little Bird can't reach them would work. Mimi says it's a good idea but the sun won't reach the seeds either – which means they won't grow. The only thing that seems to stop t Little Bird is when she sees Jess and is frightened away. But Jess can't stand still in the vegetable patch forever! Willow sees him and tells him he's being a scarecrow. A scarecrow? Yes, something that scares away the birds. Mimi has a brilliant idea to make the perfect scarecrow. A Jess scarecrow. Little Bird stops eating the lettuce seeds and eats from the lovely bird table they put out for her instead. Hooray!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Baa and Billie have built a fantastic new see-saw in the meadow. Jess can't wait to have a go. But when he tries to make it go up and down with him on one end and Baa and Billie on the other he just gets stuck in the air and can't get the see saw down. ‘How can I go up and down on the see saw?' he asks? -desperate to have all the ‘up and down' fun he see the puppies having when they jump on the see-saw. Jess asks Horace the hoppy frog what he knows about ‘up and down', he talks to Willow about scales and weighing things until finally he works it out – if he finds someone roughly the same weight as him – balanced just like the puppies were - he'll do it! He works out that Mimi - of all his friends- weighs about the same as him and just as he worked out they jump on the see saw and go up and down, up and down and have a fantastic time! Yippety Yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess shows Mimi his lovely Nature Collection. She really likes it and wonders what he's going to do with it. Now that's a good question! Jess thinks he'll display it but with the pups racing around it'd soon get damaged. He asks Horace if he could use it to make musical instruments, some things make a great sound but others aren't so good. It's time to go on a picnic with Mimi and his friends. Jess brings his Nature Collection along and when all his friends want to play a game Jess has a great idea. He's found the perfect thing to do with his Nature Collection! programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: JESS and the pups give Baa a peach to eat, thinking it will make a change from grass. But the peach is too hard. How can I make my peach soft? Asks Jess. That's the Big Question! programme.desc: JESS, JOEY and JINX go to the Whispering Woods in the hope of seeing some butterflies, but the puppies are so lively and noisy that they frighten them away. JESS wonders “how can we hide to watch butterflies?” That's the Big Question! JESS decides to make somewhere to hide out of natural materials. The puppies and Jess try to build a hide out of stones but they're too heavy and all fall down. Jess thinks that something lighter might work well but when they try to build a hide out of straw it's TOO light and flies away in the wind. JESS is stuck - there must be some other material on Greendale Farm they could use. But all that's around them are trees. Jess works out that trees are made out of wood and there are lots of old wooden apple crates in Willow's Stable which will do the job perfectly. JESS, JOEY and JINX build a butterfly hide out of wooden apple crates and soon see lots and lots of beautiful butterflies. Yippety yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: It's a snowy day on Greendale Farm so Jess and his friends have a race down Cherry Hill. Jess wants to win the race but he can't run as fast in the snow. “How can I go faster than Joey and Jinx?” Thinks Jess. That's the Big Question. First, Jess tries rolling down the hill like the puppies but he's not a good roller so that doesn't work. Horace shows Jess how he slides down his slide in the pond. Jess tries again at Cherry Hill but can't get going. Helped by Billie and Baa he remembers everything that Horace did - pushing off, going ‘Wheeeee! and lifting his legs up - but nothing works; he ends up sitting in the snow and not sliding at all. He needs something that will move on its own like Mimi's trolley! Jess tries sliding down the hill on the trolley but the wheels get stuck in the snow. Jess decides to take the wheels off and see if the trolley moves faster. Jess whizzes down the hill on the trolley top much faster than the rolling puppies. It's brilliant fun and he's answered the question. Yippety Ya.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: It's Harvest time and Jess and his friends are having a special harvest breakfast. But all there is to eat is grass! Jess wonders, “What shall we have for our harvest breakfast?” That's the Big Question! Baa likes juicy things to eat. Jess remembers that he saw some juicy blackberries on his way to Buttercup Meadow. He and Baa go and pick some. They taste delicious, but it's still not quite perfect. Billie wants something crunchy. Jess remembers seeing some crunchy hazelnuts on the way to the blackberries. He and Billie go and collect some hazelnuts. Juicy and crunchy is fantastic, but it's still not perfect. “What about something chewy” suggests Willow. Jess remembers that he and Billie found some chewy oats on their way to the hazelnut tree. So he and Willow fetch some oats. It's tasty but it's still a bit dry – until Jess adds the final touch - some milk. Perfect! They've made delicious juicy-crunchy-chewy-mushy muesli! And what's more, Jess has answered his Big Question. Yippety Yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess and Mimi are decorating hats. Mimi can't decide which of her two hats to wear – the one decorated with flowers or the one decorated with berries? It's a Big Question to answer! Baa and Billie are having fun making shadow shapes on the barn door so they go and ask them for advice. Jess suggests that he and Baa model the hats for Mimi. They look great but Mimi still doesn't know what they'd look like on her. JESS remembers the shadows that Baa was making earlier and suggests that she could wear a hat and look at her shadow to see what it looks like. Mimi tries it but she still can't see herself properly. It's just an outline. Undeterred, Jess suggests that they go and ask Horace for help. At the pond they meet the puppies who tel them about their new puppy friends who live in the pond. Jess realises that the puppies are looking at themselves reflected in the water. He realises that MIMI too may be able to see herself in the water. And of course she can! HORACE arrives and tell them that he's alway.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess shows us his little tree: a beautiful flowering shrub in full bloom. He tells us that his little tree didn't always look like this...there was a time when the tree's leaves turned yellow! What's happening to my little tree? That's the Big Question! Jess asks Mimi for help, but she's in bed with a bad cold. She's drinking lots of fluids to help make her better. Jess gives his little tree some more water to help make it better but when he goes to check on his tree the next day the leaves have turned brown and crinkly! Baa and Billie come along - Billie is tucked in the brim of Baa's woolly hat, it's too cold for her to come out. Jess wonders if his little tree is cold and needs warming up. So he wraps a potato sack round the little tree. But the next day things are even worse the leaves are falling off.! And it's happening all over Greendale Farm! Jess goes to see Horace who is busy composing a new song. It's all about the Seasons. Jess finally realises that what's happening to his tree is perfe.

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: It's the day of Mimi's dance in Jess's barn but its too hot to move, let alone dance. Jess wonders how they can all keep cool! That's the BIG QUESTION. Jess asks his friends for ideas. Horace keeps cool by swimming under water, but that's no good for Jess and everyone else who can't swim. The puppies keep cool by panting, but that just makes Jess even hotter and out of breath. And Willow keeps cool by standing very still. That won't work for a dance, they can't all keep still! Mimi comes past holding a little fan which makes a lovely cool breeze. Jess realises that what they need is a giant fan that could make a cool breeze in the barn. He and Mimi make a huge fan which Horace works as part of his one-man band. Everyone has a great time dancing and keeping cool. Jess has answered the Question. Yippety Yay!

programme.desc: Jess and the puppies find a pile of acorns buried under a tree. The puppies want to play with them, but Jess thinks they should find out why the acorns are buried there first. That's the Big Question! Baa and Billie don't know – Billie says she'd eat acorns rather than bury them! Jess goes off to see Mimi who's planting her conker to grow a chestnut tree. Jess wonders if someone planted the acorns to grown into an oak but Mimi doesn't think so. They'd need to be buried somewhere with more space to grow. Jess tries Willow who is storing apples for the winter. She explains that she'll eat the apples when food is scarce in the winter months. Jess wonders if someone is storing the acorns. He and the puppies go back to the tree and wait. Soon a Squirrel pops out from the tree and buries another acorn. Jess and the pups are glad they didn't play with the acorns. Squirrel's storing them for Winter. They've answered the question – yippety yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Brown Bird sings a lovely song before leaving for winter migration. Jess would love to sound like Brown Bird – then they could listen to her song all year round. But how can he sound like her? That's the Big Question. Billie and Baa suggest Jess sings but his singing voice doesn't sound like Brown Bird at all. Mimi tries to mimic Brown Bird by whistling but that's not the right sound either. Maybe if Jess makes a hooty sound by blowing through his paws? That's still not the right sound. Jess tells his friends that it's more of a whistley sound – a bit like the wind whistling through the reeds at Horace's pond. So they go to the pond. Horace shows Jess how to blow through the reeds – and it sounds just like Brown Bird. They've found the Answer. Yippety yay!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: Jess and Horace want to play Boat Racing on the pond - but first the need work out how to make a boat! Some things are too heavy, some are too light… having tried lots of options and worked out that they need something light and boat shaped, they make Mimi's paper hats into boats for their boat race. Perfect!

programme.title: Guess with Jess
programme.desc: It's Willow's apple picking party today, but some of the friends just are too chilly to go. Jess tries to work out how to keep them all warm, should they cover themselves in mud just like frogs do? Should they wrap themselves up in straw? Or might running around be the trick to getting them all toasty warm?

programme.title: CSI S5 E11 - Who Shot Sherlock?
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

programme.title: CSI S5 E17 - Compulsion
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). From the creative storytelling (\"4x4\") to the macabre (\"Who Shot Sherlock?\"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

This unique boxing show offers all-round entertainment, with live performances, lavish costumes and real fights with blood!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Extreme Ends
programme.desc: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Filipino actor, model and swimmer Enchong Dee and his celebrity friend Ria, to explore the highs and lows of Hong Kong. They are eager to push their boundaries in this thrilling new adventure.

programme.title: Iron Squad W
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation….

programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Design X Stories
programme.desc: Today's theme: Playful Everyday Fabric. Textiles are everywhere in our lives. From bold patterns and vivid colors to updated designs for traditional cloth. Explore a world of playful fabric designs.

programme.title: Design Ah neo: Underthe Lid
programme.desc: Design is fun! Design feels good! Cutting-edge images and music guide children to enjoy exploring the ideas and tweaks in the designs all around us. An episode on Under the Lid.

programme.title: Mitateru-phose #1
programme.desc: This program employs \"mitateru,\" a Japanese technique, to inspire children's imagination by encouraging them to view objects differently and develop their unique perspectives and creativity.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: SAMURAI CASTLES: Okayama
programme.desc: Okayama Castle is unique and puzzles visitors. The keep shows a different face, depending on the direction, and each floor is a different shape. We look at how this mysterious castle was built.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history and culture. This episode focuses on \"fumu,\" meaning \"to step.\" Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.title: MATSURI: The Heartbeat of Japan
programme.desc: Kagura is a traditional performance of music and dance. Buzen Kagura features 24 well-known pieces including an acrobatic feat and a tale from Japanese myth. Children present the same pieces.

programme.title: BOSAI: Heavy Snow
programme.desc: Heavy snow falling in a short time can threaten lives when it piles up on roofs, paralyzes roads, and brings social functions to a halt. We'll examine the reasons why heavy snows falls on Japan.

programme.desc: Igarashi Hisae (Interior designer) visits Osaka. Glass was a key industry in Osaka from the early 1900s. Igarashi learns how glassblowers used their skills to make Japanese vacuum flasks.

programme.title: Miracle In Cell No.7
programme.desc: Joselito is a mentally-challenged man who is wrongfully charged with sexually assaulting and murdering a little girl. In prison, he becomes friends with his fellow inmates and together they form a plan to smuggle his young daughter inside the cell! Years after, his daughter becomes a lawyer and is determined to prove her father's innocence.

programme.desc: An actor with an illustrious career decides to write, direct, and act in a film that will inevitably bring him closer to his own demise before revealing that his truth may actually be far from what he has become.
